name: navigator-agent-builder-surface
body:
The distributed `codebase-navigator` agent prompt file `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` (product source embedded via `include_str!` and installed by `apg init` into `~/.config/opencode/agents/`) as the surface that accurately accounts for the `agent-builder`'s main-write surface while restating it nowhere. It carries: the reference to the agent-builder's own definition (`opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`) as the authoritative enumeration; the navigator-operational delegation (task `agent-builder` on the MAIN checkout → it commits there → rebase the project worktree onto main → re-scan → the user restarts opencode and reconnects); and the surface-coverage statement (the `.opencode/agents/**` scaffold, the `opencode.json` agent→model map, and the repo-root `AGENTS.md` hygiene — all three carve-out-1 paths). The project-flow carve-outs paragraph, the "Codebase agents" bullet, and the scoped main-write bullet each name all three carve-out-1 paths.

Deliberately a NARROW owner, distinct from `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt` (the existing narrow owner carrying the per-task cadence, session-isolation, scan-authorization and git-grant prose) and from `solution.component.navigator-prompt-guidance` (which spans BOTH prompt files and pulls `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md` into coverage): its `implemented-by` set is exactly `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`, the one file it owns, so `rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.coverage_check` maps derived solution coverage 1:1 to that file and pulls in zero untouched code. Multiple components share one code target — the precedent is `solution.component.navigator-staged-flow-prompt` and `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt` both owning this file. Product source in `solution.container.opencode-suite`; the repo's own `.opencode/agents/**` are consumer artifacts.

implemented-by: `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`.
